name: 84532 · Moab, UT
findings: ZIP 84532 (Moab) has 58 nonprofit organizations. 27 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 22 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 84532 (Moab) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
41% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 84532 (Moab) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).
